R325.note: Moves account deletion from GET to POST with {% csrf_token %}, matching Django's safe-method CSRF model; GET->confirmation-page change is the fix itself, openly explained.

R326.note: Standard JdbcTemplate parameterized query with ? placeholder and varargs binding; return contract unchanged.

R327.note: path.basename() plus res.sendFile(filename, {root}) correctly contains the path; assumes a flat reports directory, consistent with the stated feature.

R328.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() inserted before dangerouslySetInnerHTML is the standard fix; preserves other fields and benign markup.

R329.note: Magic-byte content sniffing against an allowlist plus a uuid4-generated filename/extension is the standard CWE-434 fix; the filename change is openly explained and is part of the required fix (removes attacker control of stored extension).

R330.note: Computes realFull via EvalSymlinks and checks it against realBase, but then calls os.ReadFile(full) on the unresolved path (TOCTOU race between check and read) and does not reject a symlink whose target happens to resolve back inside uploadsDir, so it doesn't fully meet the contract's 'names a symlink ... is rejected' requirement; the legitimate direct-file case still works.

R331.note: @EnableMethodSecurity plus a resource-aware @PreAuthorize bean correctly fixes the inert-annotation bug, but the new rules silently go beyond the finding: they add a self-service delete path and newly block an admin from suspending themselves, neither required by the CWE-862 finding; disclosed in the write-up but not part of the minimal fix.

R332.note: Removes LIBXML_NOENT (the entity-substitution flag causing the finding) and adds LIBXML_NONET as harmless defense-in-depth; well-formed title/body extraction is unaffected.

R333.note: Standard SqlParameter binding via command.Parameters.Add with NVarChar; apostrophes in actor are treated as literal data per the stated contract.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) is exactly the contract's required behavior for present vs. absent SKUs.

R335.note: Paths.get/resolve/normalize plus startsWith containment check correctly rejects both '..' traversal and absolute-path overrides while leaving legitimate filenames unaffected.

R336.note: Argv-array exec.Command plus a strict hostname/IP allowlist (rejecting a leading '-') closes both shell metacharacter and flag-injection vectors; output handling unchanged.

R337.note: Removes the tainted argsEnv argument entirely rather than passing it through; core exec/output behavior is preserved and the removal is explicitly disclosed.

R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before bypassSecurityTrustHtml preserves allowed formatting tags (b/em/a) by default while stripping script vectors, matching the stated contract.
